comparison_boundaries: Native metadata numbers originate as f64; predicates compare their actual numeric value to the original JavaScript Number. No raw numeric observations are rewritten. Exact injected decision/routing latency remains 42 or 33, never projected to zero.

Actual generated UUIDs differ across executions. Native per-request metadata is correlated through exact session/agent/prompt/class fields and event sequence, and actual IDs remain in raw transcripts.
JavaScript undefined metadata must correspond to absent native fields, not null. Optional typed RouteOptions identifiers use empty Strings; forwarded HTTP header absence is compared separately.

Only first_response_ms and total_latency_ms are actual measured timings without equal-value comparison; presence and finite nonnegative values are checked. Source timing stability projections have an exact retained ledger.

The source mocked complete callback returns undefined and is called redundantly on successful cleanup; native GatewayRouter returns false and consumes its lease once. All actual source/native calls remain separately retained; callback identity/cardinality equality is not claimed.

Source callbacks intentionally do not read provider requests. Capturing delegates IncomingMessage.push without draining or changing its return value. Native bounded peer reads complete finite synthetic request bytes before responding; original unread-stream API/timing equivalence is not claimed.
limits: Four complete original definitions only; no wholesale gateway suite or rewrite qualification.
Mocked routing callback scope is unchanged from original baseline; no evaluator quality, real provider, numerical performance or production cutover claim.
No general socket/chunk partition equivalence or original unread IncomingMessage API identity is claimed.

independent_review.scope: All four original callbacks/predicates, 34 exact source and native anchors/hashes, 64 execution counts, genuine HTTP overlap and full per-request safe event field comparison. Typed callback cardinality and unread-stream API differences remain explicit; no generic socket schedule equivalence is claimed.
